messages:
Maya: kicking off Heliochip joint benchmark planning. goal: perf/W + throughput matrix for marketplace entry. need telemetry, run owners, and a short comms plan. @Aria can Heliochip provide board-level power and a host-side counter export?
Connor: for acceptance criteria propose: sustained throughput >= target QPS with perf/W delta vs baseline > 10% and no functional diffs on our eval prompts. also want 99th latency below X ms for interactive config.
Aria (Heliochip): we can stream board_power_w, gpu_vdd_w, and skin_temp_c via mfg-bmc. host-side we can expose perf_event counters. we also have a Fluke 435 for external validation. firmware tweak might be required to increase sampling to 0.5s, ETA ~3 business days.
Maya: OK. can we split runs: quick baseline with current sensors, then a 2hr tuned sweep after fw? we need a fast baseline to unblock marketplace listing.
Diego: infra note  Redwood should run the baseline in Dedicated (isolated pool); Heliochip lab runs the validated long-run. agree on sync points.
Connor: workload proposal: rdx-70b-int8 chat-longtail (seq=1024), batched generation (batch=8), embeddings microbench. each workload 30m steady-state + a 2hr stability perf/W run for the combined config. sample harness: 
```
./bench.sh --model rdx-70b-int8 --seq 1024 --batch 8 --qps 120 --time 1800 --telemetry /tmp/helio_baseline.json
```
Maya: Aria, can Heliochip attach the Fluke logs (time-synced) so we have an independent perf/W figure?
Aria (Heliochip): yes, we'll NTP sync and provide meter CSVs. we'll include lines: timestamp, Vrms, Irms, power_w. any preferred format?
Connor: CSV with ISO8601 timestamps fine. we want aggregated 1s buckets; raw samples on anomalies. also include per-request token counts.
Diego: infra spec: reserving 3x A100-80G equiv nodes in Dedicated with same driver/kernel as Helio lab. will post AMI/container + docker sha.
Maya: legal/compliance: partner ops requires a data sharing addendum before publishing numbers. Trevor from partner ops will share the template. publication blocked until signed, but internal staging is ok.
Aria (Heliochip): small caveat: our SOC has an "energy_profile" kernel knob that biases voltage/freq. for phase A use default, phase B test energy_profile=performance and energy_profile=balanced. will add named tags in metadata.
Connor: include config names: perf_default, perf_mode, balanced_mode. add to run metadata for dashboarding.
Maya: marketing asks for a single-sentence joint blurb + a quote. we should draft once phase A is green. target webinar 10 business days from now if phase B completes.
Aria (Heliochip): timeline: sensor sample rate tweak = 3 days QA, Fluke setup and meter logs immediate. we can start baseline next 48hrs if Redwood infra is ready.
Diego: bench orchestration: bench-bot will run a smoke on the harness on merge. bench-bot: please run minimal smoke and post exit code + link.
bench-bot: queued smoke run. will report back. :robot_face:
Maya: action items: 1) Aria: deliver sensor CSV schema + meter hookup doc by EOD tomorrow. 2) Diego: AMI/container + cluster reservation details by tomorrow. 3) Connor: provide eval prompt set + acceptance thresholds (numbers) by day after tomorrow. 4) bench-bot: smoke run and short summary.
Aria (Heliochip): ack. will include thermal headroom and sustained power cap numbers.
Connor: GH run matrix summary (pasting): workloads=[chat_longtail, batched_gen, embed_micro]; durations=[1800,1800,1200]; modes=[perf_default, perf_mode, balanced_mode]; telemetry=[board_power, fluke_meter, host_counters].
Maya: perfect. last check: do we need an NDA amendment for publishing vendor power numbers? legal will advise.
Diego: partner ops will coordinate. shouldn't block baseline.
bench-bot: smoke run complete: harness started, telemetry endpoints reachable, basic sanity checks passed. summary: 2/2 smoke tests ok. logs: https://redwood.internal/bench/4467899012/smoke
Maya: great, proceeding to provision Dedicated runway. will schedule sync for Friday 11am PT to review results. thanks all. :rocket:
